## DeriveMaker type

The `d` a provider's `derived` receives: `d(inputs, compute, spec)` makes a derived field whose  function receives exactly its inputs, typed.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type DeriveMaker<R extends object, Meta> = <const I extends keyof R & string, T>(inputs: readonly I[], compute: (row: {
    readonly [P in I]: R[P];
}) => T, spec: FieldSpec<T, Meta>) => DerivedField<R, T, Meta>;
```
**References:** [FieldSpec](./hopgraph.fieldspec.md)<!-- -->, [DerivedField](./hopgraph.derivedfield.md)
